top_story.headline: Lobbyists logged emails and a July 14 meeting for Thailand with Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, plus requests for Rubio and Lutnick
top_story.dek: A single Continental Strategy supplemental statement lists a string of Thai government requests to the White House, State Department and Commerce Department.
paragraphs: Continental Strategy LLC reports in a FARA supplemental statement (stamped Sept. 30) that it worked for the Royal Thai Government (Thailand), through the Office of Commercial Affairs at the Royal Thai Embassy on behalf of the Ministry of Commerce. The log shows a 07/14/2026 meeting between Susie Wiles, White House Chief of Staff, and Deputy Prime Minister Suphajee Suthumpun. On 07/08/2026 it shows an email meeting request for Wiles sent to her special assistant, Sarah Schuringa. It also shows a same-day email request for a meeting between Secretary of State Marco Rubio and the Deputy Prime Minister, sent to Virginia Hinzman, listed as scheduler. Filing.

The same log shows an emailed request on 04/30/2026 for a pull-aside with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and an email on 07/16/2026 to Lutnick, logged as a meeting request. Its entries for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana include a 07/13/2026 emailed meeting request for Rubio or Deputy Secretary Landau (as the filing reads). The OCR interleaves the log columns, so each date and recipient is reported as the text reads.

Four other contacts with cabinet-level officials appear in filings stamped Sept. 30 or earlier: a phone call with CIA Director John Ratcliffe, a Lutnick meeting for a Grenada-related client, a Lutnick invitation from a German trade group, and a logged phone call with Donald J. Trump for the FII Institute. All are in the Contacts section below.

sections.headline: Calls, emails and meetings logged with the President, State, Commerce and CIA
paragraphs: Nine FARA filings and one LDA report show real communications. The rest of the 21 flagged filings only mention officials, such as news clippings and policy discussions, and are set aside. No texts are logged.

items: President Donald Trump: Richard Attias & Associates LLC logged a phone call on 03/25/2026 with "Donald J. Trump" about event programming, for the FII Institute (Saudi Arabia, per the firm's informational-materials filing). The same date shows calls with Donald Trump Jr. and Danny Townsend. Supplemental statement; companion informational materials.

Susie Wiles, White House Chief of Staff: Continental Strategy LLC for the Royal Thai Government (Thailand) logged an email on 07/08/2026 to Wiles's special assistant, Sarah Schuringa, requesting a meeting for Wiles and the Deputy Prime Minister. It also logged a 07/14/2026 meeting between Wiles and Deputy Prime Minister Suphajee Suthumpun. Filing.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio: Continental Strategy LLC logged an email on 07/08/2026 to Virginia Hinzman, listed as scheduler, requesting a meeting for Rubio and Thailand's Deputy Prime Minister (Royal Thai Government). A 07/13/2026 email for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana (Guyana) requested a meeting for Rubio or Deputy Secretary Landau. Filing.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick: Continental Strategy LLC for the Royal Thai Government (Thailand) logged an emailed request on 04/30/2026 for a pull-aside with Lutnick and a 07/16/2026 email to Lutnick logged as a meeting request. Filing.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick: Valcour, LLC logged a 05/20/2026 meeting with Lutnick on U.S.-Grenada trade and investment cooperation, for Megapath Communications Ltd.; the OCR does not show the country. Filing.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick: Delegation of German Industry and Commerce in Washington DC, LLC logged a 07/23/2026 email or online-form invitation to Lutnick to give remarks at its Oktoberfest. The principal is DIHK DEinternational GmbH (Germany, per its informational-materials filing). Filing; informational materials.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick: Brownstein Hyatt Farber Schreck, LLP for the Government of Iceland logged "multiple calls" on 03/09/2026, with Samantha Carl-Yoder listed as the firm's principal. They discussed a potential meeting between Iceland's foreign minister and Lutnick. The OCR cuts off the contact's name. Filing.

CIA Director John Ratcliffe: KAConsulting LLC logged a 08/05/2026 phone call with Ratcliffe to discuss interest and participation in Yalta European Strategy, for the UK Office of the Victor Pinchuk Foundation. Filing.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio: Christopher John Neiweem, for the Sudan People's Liberation Movement/In Opposition (South Sudan), filed informational materials containing a letter dated August 25, 2026 addressed to Rubio about South Sudan's crises. His supplemental statement says his only reportable activity was setting up a meeting with Rep. Rich McCormick about a letter McCormick transmitted to Rubio; the OCR does not say who wrote the August 25 letter. Informational materials; Supplemental statement.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

sections.headline: Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz filed 8 trade reports last year, none in 91 days
paragraphs: 1 House member(s) with a history of frequent stock trading have stopped filing trade reports.

items: Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz (D-FL-25) filed 8 periodic transaction reports in the 12 months from 7/15/2025 to 7/15/2026, and none in the 91 days since the last, on 7/14/2026

blocks.text: House members who filed 6 or more periodic transaction reports (STOCK Act trade disclosures) in the year before the last 90 days and none since, per the House Clerk's disclosure index. Silence doesn't say why: the member may have sold off holdings, moved assets into a blind trust or index fund, been covered by a new law, or just not traded -- and trades are reportable up to 45 days late, so the latest ones may not be filed yet. House members only; the Senate's e-filing search isn't covered.
